name: DINKFLIX Web
overview: A premium, lightweight desktop redesign for Jellyfin Web.
description: DINKFLIX Web replaces the desktop Jellyfin Web browsing experience with custom navigation, a recently-added cinematic hero, discovery rows, dedicated Movies and TV Shows grids, My List, search, rich title details and a human project page.

versions.changelog: DINKFLIX Web 2.1.0.0: desktop-first Jellyfin 12.1 experience with custom navigation, discovery, library grids, My List and detail pages.
